info.title: Traigent Billing — AWS Marketplace Integration
info.description: Public-surface Flask routes covering the AWS Marketplace purchase-to-account bridge: the anonymous registration landing page, the authenticated claim step, and the inbound EventBridge lifecycle-event webhook. Modeled on billing/paddle_endpoints.json. Source: src/routes/marketplace_routes.py, registered under url_prefix=/api/v1/billing/marketplace in src/routes/api_v1.py.

post.summary: Anonymous: resolve an AWS Marketplace registration token and stage a claimable pending registration
post.description: AWS posts the buyer here directly from the AWS Marketplace listing; there is no authenticated session yet. On success the buyer is redirected (303) into the portal's complete step with the new bearer handle as a query parameter -- nothing entitling happens until that step runs. No JSON body is returned on success.

303.description: Registration staged; redirect (Location header) to the complete step carrying the new bearer handle. No response body.

400.description: The x-amzn-marketplace-token field was missing from both form data and JSON body.

404.description: AWS Marketplace integration is not enabled in this deployment.

502.description: AWS could not resolve the supplied token.

post.summary: Authenticated: claim a pending AWS Marketplace registration into the caller's own tenant
post.description: Requires an authenticated session (require_auth). The tenant a purchase is claimed into always comes from the canonical, authorization-checked session context, never from the request body -- an optional tenant_id in the body is accepted only as an assertion that must agree with it.

400.description: registration_id was missing from the JSON body.

401.description: Unauthorized (no authenticated session). Body shape is the shared require_auth() envelope, not the marketplace-specific error body.

403.description: The asserted tenant_id disagreed with the authenticated session's own tenant.

404.description: AWS Marketplace integration is not enabled, or the registration handle was never found.

409.description: The registration was already claimed, or the tenant already has an entitling Paddle subscription, or this purchase is already linked to a different tenant.

post.summary: AWS-only: ingest an AWS Marketplace EventBridge lifecycle event
post.description: Authenticated by a shared secret in the X-Traigent-Marketplace-Secret header (constant-time compared), not by a user session. Idempotent by event id: a duplicate delivery is a no-op.

200.description: Event recorded/processed; see `result` for the exact outcome.

400.description: The body was not a JSON object, or was missing a truthy `id`.

401.description: The X-Traigent-Marketplace-Secret header did not match the configured shared secret.

404.description: AWS Marketplace integration is not enabled in this deployment.
